entities.name: Fun'ya no Yasuhide
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fun'ya no Yasuhide, also Bunya no Yasuhide , also known by his nickname Bunrin (文琳) was an early Heian period poet, included in the Rokkasen. He attained Senior Sixth Rank, Upper Grade.
